defect.evidence_quote: ## Rule A brief investigative stop must rest on specific, objective facts, not a hunch:
defect.locator_note: Terry lake pin-21; no text/Terry file disclosed.
defect.problem: The black-letter statement contains a direct quote and pin to Terry page 21 that cannot be verified from disclosed evidence; lake pin-21 does not contain the quoted language and is marked quote_fidelity=mismatch/pinpoint_status=slip-only. The opening phrasing also overstates the rule by saying a Terry stop rests on two showings; the second showing supports a frisk, not every stop.
defect.proposed_fix: Revise to: A Terry stop-and-frisk has two separate showings: the stop requires reasonable suspicion that criminal activity may be afoot; a frisk requires separate reasonable suspicion that the person is armed and presently dangerous. Remove the direct pin-21 quote unless full text or a matched pinpoint verifies it.

residual_risks: Full opinion text could verify the quote, but it is not disclosed in this workspace.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Separate the stop rule from the frisk rule and either replace the pin-21 quotation with a verified pinpoint or paraphrase without quotation marks.
